m.s: Take {scotch} out of the fridge 45 minutes before cooking and salt it well on both sides. Room-temperature steak cooks evenly all the way through.

Heat the oven to 220°C. Halve {potato} and boil in salted water for 10 minutes. Drain, then crush lightly on an oiled tray with chopped {rosemary*0.5} and salt. Roast for 35 minutes until deep golden.
Finely chop {parsley} and {garlic}. Mix with {chilliflakes}, {oregano}, {whitevinegar}, a pinch of salt and enough oil to loosen it (about 3 tbsp per 2 serves). Leave it to sit while you cook.

Heat a heavy frying pan over high heat until smoking. Sear the steaks for 3 to 4 minutes a side for medium-rare (55°C inside). In the last minute add {butter} and a sprig of the rest of the rosemary, and spoon the foaming butter over the steaks.
Rest the steaks on a board for 8 minutes. Don't skip this. Meanwhile blister {greenbeans} in the same pan for 3 minutes with a squeeze of {lemon}.
Slice the steak against the grain, spoon over the chimichurri, and serve with the potatoes and beans.

l: Slice the steak thin and pack it over the potatoes and beans, chimichurri in a little container. Great cold or barely warm. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.
